## Example 7.4 {#ss7-example-7-4 .lim-lesson }

<div class="eyebrow">Advanced 2015 HSC 11d · 2 marks</div>

Find the limiting sum of the geometric series

$$1-\frac14+\frac1{16}-\frac1{64}+\cdots.$$

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 45 · Example 7.4</p>

::: notes

Complete in OneNote. a=1, r=−1/4. State |r|<1, then S_infinity=1/[1−(−1/4)]=4/5. Preserve the HSC attribution given in the booklet. The original exam has not been independently consulted. Watch the double negative in the denominator.

:::
